channel.title: Roomdoo changelog
channel.description: The most relevant changes and improvements we ship in Roomdoo.

item.title: Invoicing: expandable payments and an Excel for your accountant
item.description: The Invoicing list takes a leap: see the payment state of every invoice, expand the payments of each one, filter by quarter and year with more powerful search, and export a far more complete Excel for your accountant —with the payments list already aggregated inside the file—. And, overall, it runs faster.

item.title: Roomdoo now speaks 7 languages, and more from May
item.description: The biggest change of the month: on top of Spanish and English, we add Galician, Catalan, Portuguese, French and German. Five new languages at once — an important step so every team can work in its own language and to open Roomdoo to more markets.

item.title: Reservations: filter, export, close the day
item.description: New Reservations section: all your operations as a list. Until now the planning was your only way to see the day; now you can filter, search and export to Excel or PDF any reservation in seconds, review your data as a table and jump to the planning in one click. A far more powerful way to prep the shift and close the day.

item.title: BookAI is live
item.description: We launch BookAI, Roomdoo's AI that centralises every hotel conversation into a single chat and automates much of the daily comms with configurable templates. More at bookai.roomdoo.com.

item.title: 2026 refactor: contacts, menu and login
item.description: The progressive refactor of the whole app kicks off to gain reliability and stability. First areas on the new architecture: contact management (lists with tabs and filters, richer form), revamped main menu, and a new login ready for multi-language support.

item.title: Community-requested features
item.description: A bundle of improvements requested by our customers to speed up day-to-day operations and improve visibility across the app.

item.title: VeriFactu for hotels
item.description: Everything about mandatory VeriFactu and how it affects your hotel. Roomdoo is already 100% compliant. Official deadlines after the December 2025 postponement: companies from 01/01/2027 and self-employed from 01/07/2027. Full detail in VeriFactu.

item.title: Mobile performance + small improvements
item.description: Mobile performance optimisation, bug fixes and small day-to-day feature adjustments.

item.title: New, improved online check-in
item.description: New mobile pre check-in flow for guests with document scanning and online payment. Faster reception, better SES data completeness. See Check-in.

item.title: Guide: exporting data for the Spanish INE occupancy survey
item.description: Step-by-step on how to export Roomdoo data for the INE (EOH occupancy survey). Detail in INE.

item.title: Automatic document scanning
item.description: The OCR document scanner auto-fills guest data on check-in. Faster, with fewer errors. See Scan documents.

item.title: SES.HOSPEDAJES integration
item.description: Integration with SES.HOSPEDAJES, the unified Spanish Ministry of the Interior platform for traveller registration. Replaces previous regional systems. Detail in SES Hospedajes.

item.title: New check-in assistants
item.description: Guided assistants in the check-in process that automatically suggest the most relevant action based on the reservation state, speeding up reception work. See Check-in.

item.title: New Roomdoo look & feel
item.description: Visual update with a new interface and lots of usability improvements. The first step of a gradual change that continues in the following months.
